comparison.objective: Pour soup from a heavy two-handled pot into a tureen and return the pot to the hob.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate two arms to lift, tilt, and lower one heavy vessel while controlling its contents.
comparison.success_condition: Enough contents reach the tureen, spill stays below threshold, and the pot finishes upright on the hob.
comparison.reason: Cooperative heavy-object pouring and spill control do not overlap precision stop setting and threaded retention.
